scope: Independent lane provenance correction review; no application source edits

findings.title: Unobserved replay matching the projected original end still consumes original lane
findings.preconditions: Real HubCore, SQLite and FakeSpotify; initial play 180 s track, first observed new occurrence at 1 s; valid controlled replacement deck changes target fresh to favorite, stored snapshot still target, restart; no observations during intervening skips.
steps: Start onboarded station, advance10s+sync, skip, advance1s+sync: target begins and receives fresh lane note at progress1000ms.
Advance5s and skip target under30s (not listed), advance60s without observing.
Replace persisted deck target lane with favorite via saveDeck and restart.
Insert target after current song in actual fake playlist order and skip into it (same playlist context).
Advance114s, skip target, sync while adjacent song starts at0s; total time is exactly original predicted end.
findings.expected: One actual listed target replay, kind null because no observed occurrence identifies its lane.
findings.actual: One listed target replay, facts.kind fresh. lane note gets endAt1790316251500 and is consumed for replay listing with that same timestamp, despite target originally skipped after6s.
findings.cause: noteLane projects lastAt+duration-progress and interprets coincident adjacent-song start as proof original occurrence completed; intervening unobserved replay remains possible.
findings.repair_direction: Do not publish definitive lane from projected end plus neighboring timestamp alone when occurrence continuity is ambiguous; preserve observed honest provenance or null.
required_regressions: Unobserved replay with completion coinciding with old predicted end and +/-slack boundaries
Original LANE-03 and prior LANE-02 closure
Long observed pause/resume, application next, restart, same-id replay, immutable past history and queue
